# AnswerReady

> A free audit that scores how ready a website is to be found, read and cited by AI answer engines such as ChatGPT Search, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.

AnswerReady fetches a public page and its robots.txt, then scores five categories out of 100: AI crawler access (30), content extractability (20), structured data (20), answer-ready content (20), and trust and discoverability (10). Every finding is deterministic and verifiable against the live page.

## Key facts
- The homepage scan is free and requires no account.
- A full 50-page report with competitor comparison costs 29 USD as a one-off.
- Weekly tracking with crawler-block alerts costs 29 USD per month.
- The crawler identifies itself as AnswerReadyBot and requests one page per scan.

## Pages
- [Home and free scan](https://answerready.io/): run an audit and read the methodology.
